newsitem.title: USA: Sunrise Medical sees profit pressure.
newsitem.headline: Sunrise Medical sees profit pressure.

text.p: Sunrise Medical Inc said Thursday it expects to see continued pressure on profitability as it restructures and consolidates operations through the end of fiscal 1998.

The medical products manufacturer said it remains confident that the restructured company "will be well-suited to compete effectively in our markets, resulting in improved profitability and increased shareholder value."

Earlier, the company posted third quarter net income of $1.1 million or $0.06 per share on sales of $158 million, compared with net income of $2.7 million or $0.14 per share on sales of $170 million last year.
